digest.component_or_area: Reconciler baseline advancement and three-way merge arbitration
propositions: The reconciler baseline is advanced from the pass-start snapshot before outbound mutations are applied, causing it to lag behind confirmed pushes by exactly one pass and making the guard premise false: local == baseline no longer means local is unchanged.

A local status revert to a previous value is suppressed from outbound when it equals the stale baseline, allowing inbound to clobber it with Jira's pre-push value, while other fields like description changed in the same window survive because they differed from baseline.
The ABA exposure affects all five inbound-mirrored fields (summary, description, priority, status, assignee) because they all share the same _suppressed_by_inbound guard, not just status.

The baseline must advance only on per-mutation success (not pass exit code) because status transitions can soft-fail with pass exit 0, and advancing on a failed mutation would create a false sync assertion that does not self-correct.
